# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SCENT)
  library(Signac)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")

output_dir   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output", "feature_scores", "scent")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Parameters/Inputs
```{r}
seurat_path  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")
celltype_tsv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
links_root_dir <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "feature_scores/scent/scent_candidate_links")
celltype_col   <- "cell_type_manual"
skip_bootstrap <- TRUE
max_bootstrap_iter <- 50000
```

```{r}
# load data 
cat("SCENT per-celltype loop \n")
seurat_all <- readRDS(seurat_path)
df_keys <- read.delim(celltype_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, strip.white = TRUE)
keys <- df_keys$celltype_key
keys <- keys[!is.na(keys) & nzchar(keys)]

cat("Processing", length(keys), "cell types\n")

# loop over cell types 
for (key in keys) {
  cat("Cell type:", key, "\n")
  sel <- as.vector(seurat_all@meta.data[[celltype_col]]) == key
  n_sel <- sum(sel, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat("cells:", n_sel, "\n")
  seurat <- seurat_all[, sel]
  
  rna_mtx  <- GetAssayData(seurat, assay = "RNA",  slot = "counts")
  atac_mtx <- GetAssayData(seurat, assay = "ATAC", slot = "counts")
  atac_mtx <- 1 * (atac_mtx > 0)
  
  if (!"nCount_RNA" %in% names(seurat@meta.data)) {
    seurat@meta.data$nUMI <- Matrix::colSums(rna_mtx)
  } else {
    seurat@meta.data$nUMI <- seurat@meta.data$nCount_RNA
  }
  seurat@meta.data$celltype <- "focal"
  
  mito.genes <- grep("^MT-", rownames(rna_mtx), value = TRUE)
  percent.mito <- if (length(mito.genes) > 0) {
    colSums(rna_mtx[mito.genes, , drop = FALSE]) / pmax(1, colSums(rna_mtx))
  } else {
    rep(0, ncol(rna_mtx))
  }
  seurat <- AddMetaData(seurat, percent.mito, col.name = "percent.mito")
  
  meta <- seurat@meta.data
  meta$log_nUMI <- log1p(meta$nUMI)
  meta$cell <- rownames(meta)
  meta <- meta[, c("cell", "nUMI", "log_nUMI", "percent.mito", "celltype")]
  
  # candidate links file (change if multiple chunks need merging)
  link_file <- file.path(links_root_dir, key, paste0("chunk_", key, "_1.txt"))
  if (!file.exists(link_file)) {
    warning("Link file not found for '", key, "': ", link_file, "  (skipping)")
    next
  }
  links <- read.table(link_file, sep = "\t", header = FALSE)
  colnames(links) <- c("gene", "peak")
  
  scent_obj <- CreateSCENTObj(
    rna = rna_mtx,
    atac = atac_mtx,
    meta.data = meta,
    peak.info = links,
    covariates = c("log_nUMI", "percent.mito"),
    celltypes = "celltype"
  )
  
  scent_obj <- SCENT_algorithm(
    object = scent_obj,
    celltype = "focal",
    ncores = 1,
    boot = !skip_bootstrap,
    maxboot = if (!skip_bootstrap) max_bootstrap_iter else NULL
  )
  
  out_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("scent_links_", key, ".tsv"))
  write.table(
    scent_obj@SCENT.result,
    out_file,
    sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
  )
  cat("saved:", out_file, "\n")
}

cat("\nAll cell types processed.\n")
```
